parameters.help_en:
The list of upload task IDs (JobIds). It consists of one or more JobIds. A JobId is the value of the JobId response parameter returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86311.html operation.
A maximum of 10 IDs are supported.
Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If both are specified, only JobIds is processed
parameters.help_zh:
上传任务ID（JobId）列表。由一个或多个JobId组成，JobId为通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86311.html接口上传时，返回参数JobId的值。
最多支持10个ID。
多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds
parameters.name: job_ids

parameters.help_en:
The list of URLs of the video source files to upload. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). A maximum of 10 URLs are supported.
URL-encode the URLs before you use them.
If the same video URL is uploaded multiple times, specify a single URL for the query.
You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If both are specified, only JobIds is processed
parameters.help_zh:
上传视频源文件URL列表。多个URL之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持10个。
使用前，先进行URL编码。
如果同一URL视频多次上传，建议传入单个URL进行查询。
JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds
parameters.name: upload_urls
